normal2: one zero_grad, two sumCE/(2*18336) backwards, one AdamW step
precision: unchanged FP32 network; original float64 posterior

ema.update: after every complete normal2 step, including step1

accuracy.primary: per-training-seed mean of per-graph absolute total edge error vs926
accuracy.consistent_gain: strictly lower primary error in BOTH training seeds
accuracy.pooled_mean_only: report tradeoff; never call consistent gain
accuracy.per_relation_errors: report alongside total error; no cancellation hidden

non_adoption_redlines_per_training_seed.zero_raw_W1: any positive EMA W1 crosses the relative redline
non_adoption_redlines_per_training_seed.meaning: human-chosen non-adoption warnings, not proven safety limits; passing is not structural acceptance

other_structure: retain joint degreeTV, typed triangles, closure/opportunities, relation counts, degree tails, MP2/MP3, connectivity and sample differences; severe degradation must be disclosed even below redlines
proposed_default_schedule: two authorized GPUs, one training trajectory each; raw/ema x two seeds sequentially on each GPU
optional_sample_parallelism: after both final readouts frozen, extra authorized idle cards may share the same eight jobs; schedule must be fixed before launch, not additional samples
